header: UNVERIFIED — traditional weekday lookup tables, entered from commonly published panchang conventions. Must be reviewed before being relied on.

provenance.notes: Entered by the autonomous build from general knowledge of the widely published tables. Not checked against a cited source.

description: The daytime (sunrise to sunset) is split into 8 equal parts numbered 1..8. For each period, segmentByWeekday[w] gives the part number for weekday w, where 0 = Sunday (Ravivara) … 6 = Saturday (Shanivara). The weekday is the vara of the panchang day.
